_about: One keepsake per recruit, given when they become Sworn (Kyle, 19 Nov 2026: 'Each sworn member will give something that goes there. it's personal to them and i have plans for it later'). Written from each recruit's Wave 1 profile in docs/recruits/. tools/build_collection.py turns each into a found-only Collection entry on the Keepsakes tab; world/bond_manager grants it on reaching Sworn. `icon` is the keepsake's own icon once its art lands; until then it shows `stand_in`.

kesten_the_catalogued.name: Kesten's First Volume
kesten_the_catalogued.blurb: The first bound volume of Kesten's record of the Scourge, in pencil. The last page has your name on it, written properly, with the day he swore to you.

adrian_templar.name: Adrián's Whistle
adrian_templar.blurb: The referee's whistle Adrián carried in his left pocket from the day he landed. He says he doesn't need to be the referee when he's with you.

tarek_templar.name: Omar's Red Pen
tarek_templar.blurb: The pen Omar gave Tarek as a joke the year they met, the one he marked Tarek's drawings with. It's nearly dry. Tarek says Omar's name is in the well now.

freja_priest.name: Freja's Pinard Horn
freja_priest.blurb: The wooden midwife's horn Freja had in her pocket the night the worlds joined, polished dark from years of use. William carved her a new one, so this one's yours.

diego_tinker.name: Diego's Blue Spudger
diego_tinker.blurb: The little blue plastic tool Diego used to open phones at a kiosk in Maracaibo, worn white at the tip. He has proper tools now, but this was the first one.

ama_priest.name: Ama's Stethoscope
ama_priest.blurb: A children's stethoscope from a London ward, with a scuffed plastic bear clipped to the tubing so frightened little ones would let Ama listen.

marcus_stormbringer.name: Marcus's Weather Meter
marcus_stormbringer.blurb: The handheld weather meter Marcus had clipped to his belt the day the worlds joined. The battery died in the first month and he carried it for three years anyway.

sondre_stormbringer.name: Sondre's Shackle Key
sondre_stormbringer.blurb: The little dinghy shackle key Sondre wore every day for four summers on the Hardangerfjord, worn smooth. He says he'll get another one when he finds a boat.

sebastian_bloodmage.name: Nélida's Chimichurri Card
sebastian_bloodmage.blurb: Sebastián's grandmother's chimichurri recipe in her own handwriting, stained with oil. He knows it by heart and wants it somewhere safe.

marco_paladin.name: The Key He Was Cutting
marco_paladin.blurb: A half-cut brass key from Marco's shop in Naples, still in his hand when he landed. It doesn't open anything. He says he's finished it now, in his way.

sophia_mage.name: Sophia's Parliament Pass
sophia_mage.blurb: Sophia's European Parliament pass on its blue lanyard, the photo faded. It got her into the booth every morning for fourteen years. She doesn't need to prove who she is any more.

carolina_shaman.name: Seu Raimundo's Compass
carolina_shaman.blurb: Carolina's grandfather's brass compass, carried on the Amazon every day and never used. She doesn't need north any more. She knows which way is downstream.

ryan_warlock.name: Ryan's First-Bonus Watch
ryan_warlock.blurb: A heavy gold watch Ryan bought with his first bonus in Boston. He's out of the business now, and a man who's out doesn't need to know what time the markets open.

hana_shaman.name: Hana's Patrol Cap
hana_shaman.blurb: Hana's red and yellow surf lifeguard's cap, faded nearly pink by fourteen summers on the beach at Port Waikato. She's on patrol here now.

esteban_bloodmage.name: Esteban's Radiation Badge
esteban_bloodmage.blurb: The badge Esteban wore on his collar through nineteen years of surgery under X-ray, its window long gone black. It counted the dose for years. Now the clauses do.

berat_tinker.name: Berat's Mouth Mirror
berat_tinker.blurb: The angled chrome dental mirror Berat kept behind his ear in his surgery in Izmir. Used twice for teeth and forty times to see round corners.

dan_warrior.name: Dan's Hi-Vis Vest
dan_warrior.blurb: The faded orange high-visibility vest Dan landed in, from his first week at a warehouse in Sheffield. He's on a proper crew now, so he doesn't need to be seen.

marisol_priest.name: Marisol's Reading Glasses
marisol_priest.blurb: Folding reading glasses in a scratched hard case, from the end of every night shift in Bogotá. She's got four beds to look after now.

silas_rogue.name: Silas's Two-Euro Coin
silas_rogue.blurb: A Belgian two-euro coin worn smooth from three years of being flipped for every decision Silas didn't want to make. He makes his own now.

rosa_hunter.name: Rosa's Binoculars
rosa_hunter.blurb: Battered field binoculars from eight years in the Tanzanian bush, the strap mended three times. Rosa's learned to see what's coming without them.

pavlo_knight.name: Pavlo's Tea Flask
pavlo_knight.blurb: A dented steel flask with no lid, given to Pavlo by his wife on his first day as a teacher. He'd like it to go somewhere that isn't a wall.

amber_druid.name: Amber's Soil Knife
amber_druid.blurb: A worn steel soil knife with a wooden handle, for digging plugs of sedge on the Oregon tide flats. Amber does most of her planting with her hands now.

ivan_warrior.name: Ivan's Cab Key
ivan_warrior.blurb: The heavy brass key to the driver's cab of Ivan's tram on Route 13 in Novosibirsk. He has a proper route now and doesn't need to pretend.

haruto_runemaster.name: Haruto's Brush Roll
haruto_runemaster.blurb: A bamboo roll of calligraphy brushes, his master's and his own. Haruto's hand won't hold them much longer, and he wanted them kept by someone who saw why they mattered.

marta_tinker.name: Marta's Oil Can
marta_tinker.blurb: A small brass oil can, dented and shiny from Marta's hand, carried on the Łódź sewing floor for nineteen years. She has a whole workshop of oil now.

lucia_suncleric.name: Dona Zuleide's Candle List
lucia_suncleric.blurb: Lúcia's grandmother's list of everybody on their street in Goiânia, folded soft. The names are written on her candle wall now.

minh_chronomancer.name: Linh's Tuning Fork
minh_chronomancer.blurb: A steel tuning fork tuned to A, its tines worn bright. Minh's daughter gave it to him so he'd have her note with him. He doesn't need to strike it to hear it any more.

bakyt_hunter.name: Ak-Kanat's Glove
bakyt_hunter.blurb: Bakyt's thick leather eagle-hunting glove, worn shiny, which carried his first eagle for twenty-two years in the Tian Shan. It should go to someone who knows what it carried.

matias_reaper.name: His Father's Ticket Punch
matias_reaper.blurb: A brass bus conductor's ticket punch, Matías's father's, clicked twice before every fight for three years. He doesn't need to start a shift any more.

tomas_warrior.name: Tomas's Carabiner
tomas_warrior.blurb: A steel climbing carabiner scratched to bare metal, clipped to Tomas's belt through eighteen years of rigging and the night he fell forty feet into this world.

cristobal_knight.name: Cristóbal's Brigadista Helmet
cristobal_knight.blurb: A scorched and dented yellow wildfire helmet, the one Cristóbal walked out of a Barrens grass fire in on his first day. His brigade have helmets of their own now.

callum_venomancer.name: Callum's Snake Hook
callum_venomancer.blurb: A steel snake hook with a worn grip, used every day at a Queensland reptile sanctuary. Callum handles things with his own hands now.

giorgi_primalist.name: The Lead Ewe's Bell
giorgi_primalist.blurb: A small dented brass bell from the lead ewe of Giorgi's flock in Kazbegi, carried knotted silent for three years. It's untied now, so it can ring.

camille_ranger.name: Camille's Spoke Wrench
camille_ranger.blurb: A slim silver bicycle-spoke wrench on a battered keyring, used to true wheels in Lyon. Never mention that she gave it to you.

liam_suncleric.name: Liam's Trauma Shears
liam_suncleric.blurb: Blunt-nosed paramedic's shears with HARTIGAN scratched into one handle. Liam's crew have their own now, and two kids who'll want to borrow them.

anjali_druid.name: Anjali's Hand Lens
anjali_druid.blurb: A brass botanist's hand lens on a cord, scratched from forty years of field seasons. Anjali says you should look closely at things.

orlando_witchdoctor.name: Orlando's Straight Razor
orlando_witchdoctor.blurb: A pearl-handled barber's razor, used every day in Santurce for eleven years. It cut the hair of everybody Orlando loved.

owen_cultist.name: Owen's CB Handset
owen_cultist.blurb: The handset from Owen's lorry radio, its coiled cord snapped off, talked into through eight years of night driving. He'd rather talk to you.

emre_rogue.name: His Uncle's First Pick
emre_rogue.blurb: The oldest pick in Emre's uncle's roll, given to him at nine to open a stuck deadbolt in Istanbul, worn thin and bright.

saoirse_starcaller.name: Saoirse's Sliotar
saoirse_starcaller.blurb: A scuffed, grass-stained camogie ball from Saoirse's last county season, thrown at the party for three years. You've caught it enough times to keep it.

pasang_primalist.name: Pasang's Ice Axe
pasang_primalist.blurb: A wooden-handled ice axe carried on nineteen expeditions above eight thousand metres. Pasang says it's climbed enough, and you should have something that's been to the top.

nicolas_bloodmage.name: Nicolás's Tourniquet Windlass
nicolas_bloodmage.blurb: The folding windlass from a paramedic's tourniquet, clipped to Nicolás's jacket on the bike in Lima. It's stopped a lot of bleeding.

iker_guardian.name: Iker's Txapela
iker_guardian.blurb: Iker's grandfather's black Basque beret, worn for every pelota match he played. The coach doesn't wear the beret. The champion does.

mateo_starcaller.name: Mateo's Red Headlamp
mateo_starcaller.blurb: A battered red-filtered headlamp from seventeen years of nights in an observatory dome above the Elqui valley. You should look up more.

imelda_primalist.name: Imelda's Hand Wraps
imelda_primalist.blurb: Soft cotton hand wraps from a gym above a tyre shop in Navotas, washed to grey and rewound every morning for nineteen years. They were tight enough.

ileana_necromancer.name: Ileana's Shoulder Rest
ileana_necromancer.blurb: The black curved shoulder rest from Ileana's violin in Cluj, strapped to her back for three years with no violin to put it on. It waited long enough.

rhys_ranger.name: Tegan's Old Bell
rhys_ranger.blurb: The little brass falconry bell and leather swivel Tegan wore in Brecon. Her old bell should go to somebody she trusts.

henrik_mage.name: Henrik's Scale Rule
henrik_mage.blurb: A triangular aluminium engineer's scale rule from a building site in Copenhagen, worn smooth. Check before you stand on it.

eino_barbarian.name: Eino's Marking Tape
eino_barbarian.blurb: A strip of orange forestry marking tape, faded to salmon, the kind that marks trees to be left standing. Eino marked you as one to leave standing.

driss_shaman.name: Driss's Torque Wrench
driss_shaman.blurb: A short, stubby torque wrench from a Land Cruiser's toolkit, in Driss's hand under a truck in the Sahara when the worlds joined. You've got further to go than he has.

thiago_paladin.name: Thiago's Blue Tape
thiago_paladin.blurb: The last few turns of a roll of bright blue kinesiology tape from a clinic in Belo Horizonte, rationed for three years. It's for the fourth.

junseo_reaper.name: Jun-seo's Welding Shade
junseo_reaper.blurb: A flip-up welder's shade from a Busan shipyard, cracked across one lens. Jun-seo would like to look at things properly now.

skye_pyromancer.name: Skye's Helmet Torch
skye_pyromancer.blurb: A yellow, smoke-stained torch from a Country Fire Authority helmet, dead for years. Skye can make her own light now, and you should have something to laugh at.

enzo_cultist.name: Enzo's Fencing Glove
enzo_cultist.blurb: A white sabre glove from a fencing salle in Naples, never worn here. It belonged to a man who did it on his own.

alonso_pyromancer.name: Alonso's Kiln Goggles
alonso_pyromancer.blurb: Smoked-glass goggles from a Talavera pottery workshop in Puebla, for looking into the fire. Something for looking straight at hard things.

vuk_knight.name: The Double Six
vuk_knight.blurb: A cast-iron domino tile, double six, from a kafana in Novi Sad. Mila has the rest of the set now, and the second bowl's full.

gunnar_barbarian.name: Gunnar's Hydrometer
gunnar_barbarian.blurb: A brass brewer's hydrometer in a worn leather sleeve, from a brewery in Akureyri. Something to measure how good things are.

kourosh_mage.name: Kourosh's Silver Pencil
kourosh_mage.blurb: A slim silver mechanical pencil, finishing a sum in a Tehran office when the worlds joined. Write something that isn't a calculation.

hector_witchdoctor.name: El Relámpago de Plata's First Mask
hector_witchdoctor.blurb: Héctor's first lucha mask, black with silver flames, sewn by his wife for his debut at twenty. Faded and patched. Only family should have it.

ziad_felsworn.name: Ziad's Earplug
ziad_felsworn.blurb: A single foam earplug on a cord, for sleeping in an ambulance between calls in Beirut. Something for blocking out the noise.

ratih_ranger.name: Ratih's Gauge Plate
ratih_ranger.blurb: A small brass river-gauge plate stamped with depth marks, torn off a flood marker in Sumatra and sewn to Ratih's sleeve for years. It marked how high the water came.

fiona_witchhunter.name: Fiona's Survival Whistle
fiona_witchhunter.blurb: The yellow whistle from an orange helicopter survival suit, on a fraying lanyard. Fiona was flying out to a North Sea rig when the worlds joined. You might need someone to hear you.

khalid_hunter.name: Hurra's Hood
khalid_hunter.blurb: A small tooled leather falconer's hood, sized for a saker falcon Khalid flew for eleven years in Al Ain. The first Hurra would want it to go somewhere quiet.

delroy_witchdoctor.name: Delroy's Baker's Apron
delroy_witchdoctor.blurb: A floury canvas apron from a bakery on Spanish Town Road in Kingston, never quite clean. Kezia's making him a new one, very badly.

karim_felsworn.name: Karim's Plumb Bob
karim_felsworn.blurb: A brass surveyor's plumb bob on a worn cord, from the desert east of Amman. It swings when something ahead is wrong, and always points straight down.

osvaldo_warlock.name: Osvaldo's Band Badge
osvaldo_warlock.blurb: A small brass name badge from a hotel band in Havana: Osvaldo, Trompeta. He's not playing for a hotel any more. He's playing for his brother.

bashir_witchhunter.name: Bashir's Chalk Line
bashir_witchhunter.blurb: A stonemason's chalk line reel, blue-dusted, from a yard in Nablus. Something for marking where to cut.

pieter_guardian.name: Pieter's Father's Knife
pieter_guardian.blurb: A groundsman's folding knife, the handle worn pale, from the mines outside Pretoria. Pieter's father would want it carried by somebody who listens.

gianluca_guardian.name: Gianluca's Coffee Tamper
gianluca_guardian.blurb: A brass barista's tamper, handle worn smooth, from a bar in Bologna at six in the morning. Something from the bar that was real.

camila_venomancer.name: Camila's Safety Glasses
camila_venomancer.blurb: Scratched lab safety glasses from an antivenom lab in Durango. The scorpids trust Camila now. Protect your eyes.

elias_suncleric.name: Elias's Inspection Mirror
elias_suncleric.blurb: A mechanic's telescoping inspection mirror from a tin-roofed workshop in Santo Domingo. Elias would rather look at what's in front of him now.

kiet_rogue.name: Kiet's Key Blank
kiet_rogue.blurb: A brass key blank on a wire loop, cut for nothing. It was meant for his grandmother's new door in Bangkok. Keep it for a door you haven't found yet.

rui_cultist.name: Rui's Net Needle
rui_cultist.blurb: A salt-bleached wooden net needle Rui's father carved, for mending nets on the Peniche sardine boats. Something his father made with his hands.

stelios_necromancer.name: Despina's Date Stamp
stelios_necromancer.blurb: A brass date stamp with a wooden handle from an old library in Thessaloniki, used to stamp every name in Stelios's register of the dead. Let it mark something happier.

nizar_chronomancer.name: Nizar's Stopped Watch
nizar_chronomancer.blurb: Nizar's father's pocket watch, its crystal cracked on the boat from Beirut. It ran backwards for three years. It's stopped now, and time can go forward again.

yusuf_venomancer.name: Yusuf's Counting Tray
yusuf_venomancer.blurb: A scratched brass pill-counting tray from a pharmacy in Basra, where Yusuf's daughter counted pills doing her homework. His numbers are in good hands.

reka_necromancer.name: Réka's Wooden Mannequin
reka_necromancer.blurb: A tiny wooden artist's mannequin with a wire in its arm, the last thing Réka animated in Budapest. It's the only puppet she never raised.

ramiro_primalist.name: Ramiro's Carbide Lamp
ramiro_primalist.blurb: A dented brass carbide headlamp from the silver mines of Potosí, out of fuel for three years and polished anyway. The men he worked beside are out of the dark now.

graham_warlock.name: Graham's Fob Watch
graham_warlock.blurb: The nurse's fob watch Graham's husband gave him the year they married, pinned upside down through nineteen years of hospice nights. It kept time while he waited.

elie_bloodmage.name: Elie's Needle Cap
elie_bloodmage.blurb: The small blue cap from the butterfly needle Elie used on his last blood draw in Beirut, clipped to his sleeve for three years. He doesn't need a needle any more.

bruno_templar.name: Bruno's Hand-Wrap
bruno_templar.blurb: A roll of black fighter's hand-wrap from Bruno's last fight in Curitiba, which he won. He fights for the Order now.
